title: 第25章 分道扬镳第26章 第一视角沉浸体验
slug: 转世成女开局攻略气运之子
content_zh:
这边方玉凝还在感慨，另一边林尘已经上手开始摸尸。
看他搜刮战利品的动作熟练，方玉凝抿了抿嘴唇，总觉得她是不是把林尘给教坏了。
“萧兄，这铁彪的储物袋中有两本二品武技、四百多块下品元晶，咱们正好五五分账。”
正当方玉凝还沉浸在自我思考时，林尘俨然已将尸体清理完毕。
看着对方似献宝一般将战利品递到自己眼前，方玉凝当即甩手。
“我只要算上之前卖情报所得，一共四千六百枚元晶。”
“至于这武技，你且自己留着吧。”
说话间，方玉凝目光扫过林尘手中所拿的两本武技。
一个是偏防御类的铁嶂身、一个是偏速度型的残虹步。
再搭配上林尘自身所经常用的气元劲+裂碑手。
防御、进攻、加身法，明显是一套的。
她就没有必要去分这份机缘了，毕竟武技这类东西，贵在精、而不在多。
就像她的叠影剑，如果炼至大成，足可一剑就将铁彪身外玄罡破开。
更何况，二品武技，对她意义不大。
反倒是林尘，学会这两个武技，实力必然大增。
到那时，即便没有异火加持，他也足以和通脉境武者抗衡。
反倒是元晶，不管是交易也好，还是后续的修炼，对自己而言，都是不可或缺的重要资源。
自家苦只有自己心里最清楚。
别看她整天跟个小富婆一样，所拥有的修炼资源，也仅仅够她修炼至四品境界。
至于再往上的境界，于她而言，几乎是一概不知。

所以她打算先将修为，修炼突破至通脉境。
再将剑法和其他所掌握的武技皆炼至小成。
如此一来，她便是有了自保之力，再施镇灵手环捕捉一只兽宠培养。
到那时，她便可以离开福州城，前往其他地方看看。
或者拜入道清宗，也是个不错的选择。
片刻后，方玉凝思绪渐收，目光沉沉的看向林尘。
“你接下来有什么打算？”
“再过些时日，便是族中大比，这段时间我打算潜心修炼，顺道回家转转。”
“萧兄，你呢？”
“我？不太清楚......或许云游四方。”
听着林尘反问，方玉凝摆摆手，说出一个略带敷衍的回答。
她还能去哪？当然也是回林家。
情绪值消耗一空，急需找林同学你做补充。
当然，这些话她也只是在心里说说。
“那既如此，小弟斗胆请萧兄去我家里做客。”
content_en:
On one side, Fang Yuning was still sighing, while on the other side, Lin Chen had already started touching the corpse.
Seeing his skillful movements in searching for trophies, Fang Yuning pursed her lips, feeling that she had taught Lin Chen a bad lesson.
"Brother Xiao, there are two second-grade martial arts books and more than 400 pieces of low-grade yuan crystals in Tie Biao's storage bag. Let's split them 50-50."
While Fang Yuning was still immersed in self-thinking, Lin Chen seemed to have finished cleaning up the body.
Seeing the other party handing the trophy to her like a treasure, Fang Yuning immediately threw away her hand.
"I only need to count the income from selling information before, and the total is 4,600 yuan crystals."
"As for this martial skill, you can keep it for yourself."
While speaking, Fang Yuning glanced at the two martial arts books in Lin Chen's hands.
One is the defense-oriented Tiezhangshen, and the other is the speed-oriented Canhongbu.
Coupled with the Qi Yuan Jin + Monument Breaking Hand that Lin Chen often uses.
Defense, offense, and body-enhancing techniques are obviously the same.
There is no need for her to share this opportunity. After all, things like martial arts are more valuable than proficiency.
Just like her Overlapping Shadow Sword, if it is refined to perfection, it can break through Tie Biao's outer mysterious gang with one sword.
What's more, second-level martial arts means little to her.
On the contrary, Lin Chen's strength will definitely increase greatly if he learns these two martial arts.
By then, even without the blessing of strange fire, he would be enough to compete with Tongmai realm warriors.
On the contrary, Yuan Jing is an indispensable and important resource for himself, whether it is trading or subsequent cultivation.
Only you know your own suffering best.
Even though she acts like a little rich woman all day long, the cultivation resources she possesses are only enough for her to cultivate to the fourth level.
As for the higher realms, she has almost no idea.
So she planned to break through her cultivation to the realm of Tongmai first.
Then practice the swordsmanship and other martial arts mastered to a small degree.
In this way, she had the power to protect herself, and then used the Soul-Suppressing Bracelet to capture a pet and cultivate it.
At that time, she can leave Fuzhou City and visit other places.
Or joining the Dao Qing Sect is also a good choice.
After a while, Fang Yuning's thoughts gradually faded away and she looked at Lin Chen with a heavy gaze.
"What are your plans next?"
"In a few days, there will be a big competition among the clan. During this time, I plan to concentrate on training and go home for a while."
"Brother Xiao, what about you?"
"Me? I don't know...maybe I'm traveling around."
Listening to Lin Chen's rhetorical question, Fang Yuning waved her hands and gave a slightly perfunctory answer.
Where else could she go? Of course, he also went back to the Lin family.
The emotional value has been depleted, and I urgently need to find you, Mr. Lin, to replenish it.
Of course, she only said these words in her heart.
"In that case, I dare to invite Brother Xiao to my home."
